Instruction: Generate code that performs a PCB analysis using the PyAEDT library. The code should start by importing necessary libraries and setting up project files and paths. It should download a specific project file and set up a temporary project directory. Then, it should open an EDB project, create a cutout on selected nets, and export it to Q3D. The code should identify pin locations on the components to define where to assign sources and sinks for Q3D and append Z elevation. After that, it should save and close the EDB, open it in Hfss 3D Layout to generate the 3D model, and export the layout to Q3D. The code should then launch the newly created Q3D project, plot it, and assign sources and sinks on nets using the previously calculated positions. It should create a setup and a frequency sweep from DC to 2GHz, analyze the project, compute ACL and ACR solutions, plot them, and finally, release the desktop.

```python
import os
import tempfile
import urllib.request
from pyaedt import Edb, Hfss3dLayout, Q3d, Desktop
from pyaedt.generic.plot import plot_3d
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Set up temporary project directory
temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
project_name = "pcb_analysis"
edb_file_url = "https://github.com/pyansys/pyaedt-assets/raw/main/edb/ANSYS-HSD_V1.aedb.tar.gz"
edb_tar_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "ANSYS-HSD_V1.aedb.tar.gz")

# Download EDB project file
urllib.request.urlretrieve(edb_file_url, edb_tar_path)

# Extract the tar.gz file
import tarfile
with tarfile.open(edb_tar_path, "r:gz") as tar:
    tar.extractall(path=temp_dir)

edb_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "ANSYS-HSD_V1.aedb")

# Launch AEDT Desktop
desktop = Desktop(specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=True, new_desktop_session=True)

# Open EDB project
edb = Edb(edb_path, edbversion="2024.1")

# Select nets for cutout
selected_nets = ["DQS0_T", "DQS0_C", "VDDQ"]

# Create cutout on selected nets
cutout = edb.cutout(
    signal_list=selected_nets,
    reference_list=["GND"],
    extent_type="Conforming",
    expansion_size=0.002,
    use_round_corner=True,
    net_expansion=0.001,
    include_partial_nets=False,
    remove_single_pin_components=True,
    keep_lines_as_path=False,
)

# Export cutout to Q3D
q3d_export_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "cutout_for_q3d.aedb")
edb.save_edb_as(q3d_export_path)

# Identify pin locations on components for source/sink assignment
pin_locations = {}
z_elevation = 0.0
for comp in edb.components.components.values():
    for pin in comp.pins.values():
        if pin.net in selected_nets:
            pos = pin.location
            pin_locations.setdefault(pin.net, []).append((pos[0], pos[1], z_elevation))

# Save and close EDB
edb.save()
edb.close()

# Open in Hfss 3D Layout to generate 3D model
hfss3d = Hfss3dLayout(projectname=None, designname=None, specified_version="2024.1", new_desktop_session=False)
hfss3d.open_edb(q3d_export_path)
hfss3d.save_project()
hfss3d.close_project()

# Export layout to Q3D
q3d_project_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "cutout_for_q3d.aedt")
hfss3d.export_to_q3d(q3d_project_path)

# Launch Q3D project
q3d = Q3d(projectname="cutout_for_q3d", specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=True, new_desktop_session=False)
q3d.save_project()

# Plot the Q3D model
plot_3d(q3d)

# Assign sources and sinks on nets using pin locations
source_names = []
sink_names = []
for net, pins in pin_locations.items():
    if len(pins) >= 2:
        source_name = f"{net}_source"
        sink_name = f"{net}_sink"
        q3d.assign_source(pins[0], net_name=net, source_name=source_name)
        q3d.assign_sink(pins[1], net_name=net, sink_name=sink_name)
        source_names.append(source_name)
        sink_names.append(sink_name)

# Create setup and frequency sweep from DC to 2GHz
setup = q3d.create_setup("Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "2GHz"
setup.update()
q3d.create_frequency_sweep(setupname="Setup1", unit="GHz", freqstart=0, freqstop=2, num_of_freq_points=201, sweep_type="LinearStep")

# Analyze the project
q3d.analyze_setup("Setup1")

# Compute ACL and ACR solutions
acl = q3d.get_ac_loss("Setup1")
acr = q3d.get_ac_resistance("Setup1")

# Plot ACL and ACR
plt.figure()
plt.plot(acl["freq"], acl["acl"])
plt.title("AC Loss vs Frequency")
plt.xlabel("Frequency (Hz)")
plt.ylabel("AC Loss (W)")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

plt.figure()
plt.plot(acr["freq"], acr["acr"])
plt.title("AC Resistance vs Frequency")
plt.xlabel("Frequency (Hz)")
plt.ylabel("AC Resistance (Ohm)")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Release AEDT Desktop
desktop.release_desktop()
```
